newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU ministers may extend pesticide measures.
newsitem.headline: EU ministers may extend pesticide measures.

text.p: European Union farm ministers are expected, on Tuesday, to back a Dutch Presidency compromise extending maximum pesticide limits in food, a Commission offcial said.
The Dutch compromise, in response to requests from several countries, would extend the range of products listed in the proposal presented to ministers in June to cover additional food products.
The original proposal extended to fruit, vegetables, cereals and food products of both animal and vegetable origin.
The proposal would extend the scope of the existing legislation (directives 76/895/CEE, 86/362/CEE, 86/363/CEE and 90/642/CEE) to dried and processed products.
The proposal would set up a rapid procedure for resolving problems due to lack of harmonisation of EU law and would introduce an EU monitoring scheme.
It would also establish a committee responsible for harmonisation of standards to replace the council procedure.
